designIntent: 全链路 AI 工具选型平台，视觉上要像雷达指挥中心、知识库和风险控制台的结合体，而不是普通导航站。

gradients.hero: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(37,99,235,.22), transparent 34%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%, rgba(124,58,237,.18), transparent 30%), linear-gradient(180deg, #F8FAFC 0%, #EEF6FF 48%, #FFFFFF 100%)

typography.fontStack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
typography.caption: 12-13px / 1.5 / 600

interaction.cardHover: translateY(-2px), shadow increase, border color to aetherBlue/20
interaction.filterActive: blue filled pill with white text
interaction.riskHover: show risk explanation and verify-before-use reminder
interaction.exportAction: download button with format icon and data freshness note
